relationship_semantics_note: Insurance premium, claim reimbursement, mutual fund, RD, NPS, and loan relationships are generation links, not always symmetric transfer pairs. Bank or card accounts show payment debits; policy, loan, investment, NPS, or RD accounts show corresponding account activity, status, or holdings where supported. Do not generate multiple payment paths for the same premium, contribution, EMI, or card bill in the same period.
claim_reimbursement_semantics: Claim reimbursement relationships are conceptual links. Raw deposit data should show an external insurer or TPA credit; insurance policy data may show claim status where supported. The insurance policy should not behave like a bank transfer source account.

required_account_relationships.rule: Monthly or occasional buffer transfers may fund ICICI RD, emergency buffer, insurance planning, or pressure-month liquidity. Both legs must be visible with matching amount and plausible timestamp gap.

Reverse self-transfers may occur when Priya needs buffer money in the salary account for card autopay, rent, insurance premium, family obligation pressure, or other primary-account obligations. Both legs must be visible.
Total amount due autopay is normally debited from the HDFC salary account around two days before the payment due date.

In pressure months, ICICI buffer may support full card payment either by first transferring funds to HDFC before autopay or by making a manual card payment from ICICI if autopay is intentionally overridden. Do not generate both HDFC autopay and ICICI manual card payment for the same statement.
Education loan EMI of ₹38750 is auto-debited monthly on the 7th from the primary salary account.
Any voluntary principal prepayment, such as a planned bonus-funded prepayment, must originate from a visible bank account and reduce loan principal separately from the regular EMI schedule.
Monthly SIP debit of ₹10000 on the 10th.
Monthly SIP debit of ₹7000 on the 11th.
Monthly SIP debit of ₹5000 on the 12th.
Monthly SIP debit of ₹3000 on the 15th.
Flexible liquid fund purchase may occur after the 20th only when surplus exists; amount can range from ₹0 to ₹10000 and is not mandatory.
Secondary savings may be used for occasional liquid fund purchases when Priya routes surplus or emergency buffer through ICICI Bank.

Monthly recurring deposit installment of ₹10000 is debited from ICICI secondary savings on the 9th. If needed, HDFC salary account should transfer funds to ICICI buffer before the RD debit, and both self-transfer legs must be visible.
Monthly NPS Tier I contribution of ₹5000 is debited on the 18th.
March tax-saving top-up of around ₹50000 should be modeled as an additional NPS Tier I contribution by default. Do not create an ELSS account unless the year arc explicitly changes this assumption.

Self health insurance annual premium of ₹24500 is paid in May. Default rail is credit card where surcharge is acceptable; otherwise HDFC salary account net banking may be used. Generate only one payment path for this premium in the year.

Parents health insurance annual premium of ₹68500 is paid in September. Default rail is credit card if surcharge is acceptable; otherwise HDFC salary account net banking may be used. Generate only one payment path for this premium in the year.
Term insurance annual premium of ₹16800 is expected in December through HDFC salary account net banking. Generate only one payment path for this premium in the year.

Activa insurance annual premium of ₹7200 is expected in March. Default rail is credit card; otherwise UPI or net banking from a visible bank account may be used. Generate only one payment path for this premium in the year.
Liquid fund redemptions should normally credit the ICICI secondary savings account, especially during pressure months.
Liquid fund redemption may alternatively credit the HDFC salary account when needed for card payment or immediate obligations.

Father medical event reimbursement may arrive from insurer or TPA after a lag, with reference amount ₹55000 and no same-day liquidity assumption. This is a conceptual relationship; raw deposit data should show an external insurer or TPA credit.

Claim reimbursement may credit the primary salary account if that is used as the registered claim payout account. This is a conceptual relationship; raw deposit data should show an external insurer or TPA credit.
Monthly father support of ₹18000 and possible father medicine support of ₹6500 should appear as ordinary UPI or IMPS transfers, not as a separate owned family account.
Monthly mother support of ₹22000 should appear as an ordinary UPI or IMPS transfer, not as a separate owned family account.

Sister contribution for father medical event may arrive later as ordinary IMPS, NEFT, or UPI credit, with reference amount ₹15000 and lag of about 12 days.

merchants_and_billers.handling_rule: Cabs, groceries, food delivery, pharmacy, utilities, travel, shopping, fuel, hospital, diagnostics, and subscriptions appear as external merchant or biller counterparties.

cash.rule: Cash is not an AA account. ATM withdrawals may appear in bank statements, but individual cash spends for vegetables, tips, repairs, or autos are not individually visible.

upi.rule: UPI is a payment rail attached to visible bank accounts, not a separate account.

credit_card_rewards.rule: Reward points are not modeled as a separate AA-visible financial account.

security_deposit.rule: Rental security deposit is not an active Priya-owned account in this universe unless a later bank transaction references it.

vehicle.rule: The 2019 Honda Activa is not a financial account. Its insurance policy is visible; fuel, service, and repairs appear as payment transactions later.

emergency_fund.rule: Emergency fund is represented through the secondary savings account and ICICI Prudential Liquid Fund, not as a separate synthetic label account.
